title: Kusanagi Nene — Everything, Even Sorrow〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to wake up since I actually managed to get up early.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our next show is gonna be our last one as members of the park's cast.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go with them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna go out there and learn as much as I can! And I'm gonna find a way to fill this park with even more smiles!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The four of us are gonna learn as much as we can and become better actors.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And if we can make our dreams come true together...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to do everything I can to achieve that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, then I'll start with the exercises Ms. Kazamatsuri showed me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This might be the most sets I can do. Doing any more is probably going to affect how I practice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ms. Kazamatsuri even said that I shouldn't do more until my body's had a chance to get used to it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (While I'm doing this, others out there are also probably doing their best to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I have to think Tsukasa and Seiryuin are doing even more.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I'm gonna have any hope of catching up to them, I don't have time to sit around.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'll get scolded again if I push myself too hard. I just have to get used to things and keep at it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Nene, you're here early!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Morning, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Were you doing solo practice all on your own? That's rather unsociable of you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What's wrong with being alone for solo practice?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! Were you having one of those super-secret training sessions?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“No... You mustn't look!
I mean it. You must not look!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Am I supposed to be the crane from that story?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The crane in the story wasn't that obnoxious about it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That could actually make for an interesting twist.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, Nene, your stamina's gone up quite a bit. I'm guessing your core feels a lot stronger now as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You often stood on one leg and even your tip-toes when you played the Cowardly Canary, but your performance felt very natural.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's right. I doubt you would've been able to do that if your core wasn't strong enough.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They noticed what I did then...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That makes me really happy. I worried about what my legs were doing just as much as getting my arms to look like real wings.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
By the way, Nene...
I have a suggestion for you since you've been working so hard. Would you like to hear it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You've got that look on your face... I dunno what you're planning, but I...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The thing is, I made some upgrades to the weighted jacket I lent you that one time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I'm telling you I'm good...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But wouldn't it be better to make use of any aids that can help you increase your stamina more efficiently?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, more efficiently you say...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you wear it like a regular jacket? That sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wait, no!
You two are saying that because neither of you have tried it on...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, Tsukasa, Emu, so you're both interested! In that case, I can bring it by tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, please do!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Don't come crying to me later, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still, it is nice knowing that we get to keep goofing off together like this...)
